thread:
alex_k: Quick sync - ACME and Orion pilots flagged conflicting launch asks. We need a concrete path: cut scope or delay. Can we align on non-negotiables and tradeoffs?

maria_p: hi. customers care most about audit + HSM, but a lot also want predictable latency. sounds like a sequencing problem.

kevin_r: runtime perspective: p99 token latency target and KV cache prewarm are must-haves for pilot quality. If we ship without cache warmup we'll see token spikes.

samir_s: infra: need a lead time of ~4 weeks for dedicated reserved pool; for the pilot we can do a smaller reserved pool with prewarm windows if product supplies traffic cadence.

elaine_w: security: HSM + auditable key lifecycle is mandatory for finance vertical. we can accept a staged HSM enablement, but not enabling HSM at all is a hard no for those customers.

alex_k: rough proposal: Path 1 (accelerated): ship with ephemeral KMS + minimal event audit, include runtime cache & batching. Path 2 (compliant): enable HSM + full audit retention, adds ~3-4 weeks and infra lead time. Which do we choose for the pilot?

kevin_r: i vote Path 1 for speed. we'll gate cache changes behind a feature flag and provide a clear rollback playbook. need agreement in writing to move to Path 2 by X date.

maria_p: customers asked explicitly for HSM. many said staged rollout ok if we promise timeline. product can offer Path 1 with guaranteed Path 2 delivery date.

samir_s: infra can support Path 1 with a tight reserved pool if product shares traffic profile + prewarm windows by EOW. Path 2 requires capacity order 2 weeks before dev starts. also will surface cost delta.

elaine_w: security accepts staged plan with the following prerequisites before enabling HSM: legal signoff, KMS->HSM migration test, and audit retention update. we'll produce a checklist.

infra-bot: Reminder: capacity-request template must be submitted 14 days prior to desired start date. https://redwood.internal/capacity-requests :robot_face:

alex_k: action list: 1) product (maria_p) to finalize traffic profile + prewarm cadence; due 1859881800. 2) runtime (kevin_r) to implement cache behind flag + rollback playbook; due 1859885400. 3) infra (samir_s) to produce reserved pool estimate once profile received; due 1859889000. 4) security/legal (elaine_w) to draft HSM migration checklist & legal points; due 1859889000.

maria_p: i'll draft a customer note outlining Path 1 and a firm Path 2 commitment date. tagging @kevin_r for rollback details to include.

kevin_r: i'll run perf comparisons (cached vs uncached) and post numbers. snippet for docs:

```
# toggle cache flag
redwood.runtime.flags.set('tenant_cache_v2', true)
# rollback
redwood.runtime.flags.set('tenant_cache_v2', false)
```

elaine_w: checklist start: key rotation plan, migration test cases, data retention update, legal signoff, enablement runbook. will share draft.

samir_s: note: if customers demand HSM immediately we may need a burst pool which increases cost ~25-40%. i'll include delta in estimate.

alex_k: sounds like consensus: go Path 1 for pilot with signed Path 2 schedule. i'll publish a decision doc and action tracker.

maria_p: one more ask: runtime, can you run an end-to-end smoke with traffic profile after cache flag enabled and share results by EOD tomorrow? helps seal the promise.

kevin_r: yes, will run two runs and post results here.

alex_k: thanks everyone. i'll post the decision note to #product and follow up on any blockers. Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
